handbookNote: Batch 2 depth expansion for the Alabama Notary practice-question pool -- same source grounding as batch 1 (Code of Alabama 1975, Title 36, Chapter 20, current general Notary Public Act eff. 9/1/2023, per temp/handbooks/al/notary.txt: the ALPJA/ALI Notary Public Training Course, the ALPJA/ALI 'Notaries Public in Alabama' pamphlet, the ALPJA Affidavit of Notary Misconduct form/commentary, the statewide Application for Notary Public Commission, and Jefferson County Probate Court's corroborating pages). Batch 2 mines the remaining atomic facts in that same source set not covered by the first 62-question batch (e.g. the required driver's license copy, the no-fee/no-test training completion rule, confidential application-page contents, Alacourt/PACER background verification, the marriage-certificate commission-expiration-date field, the notary's own pre-commissioning oath of office) plus scenario/application variants of already-covered rules using new, concrete fact patterns (conflict-of-interest, signing-authority, misdemeanor/felony spot-the-violation, and remote-notarization edge cases). No pre-2012 repealed statute content or out-of-scope Civil Law Notary material is included. Price matches batch 1's $0.99 education-only tier (2026-08-16 directive) -- Alabama still has no confirmed graded notary exam, so this remains course-aligned practice content, not exam prep.
